related.description: Use [related mode](https://vitest.dev/guide/cli.html#vitest-related) to narrow down the tests to run

configFile.description: Path to the config file. Default resolving to `vitest.config.*`, `vite.config.*`

pool.description: The pool used to run tests. Defaults to `threads`

dryRunMaxWorkers.description: The number of Vitest workers for the initial test run (dry run). Mutant runs always use one worker per test runner. Requires Vitest 4 or later.
